Puan Nur Izzati binti Jamal,

Terima kasih kerana menghubungi pihak bank. Setelah semakan dibuat, pihak bank mendapati pembelian kad anda di GoRide telah dicaj dua kali dengan jumlah yang sama, iaitu RM46.66 pada 18 Ogos 2026 (transaksi TXN-0115571 dan TXN-0115572).

Pihak bank akan memulangkan RM46.66, iaitu jumlah caj yang kedua (TXN-0115572), ke akaun anda dalam tempoh 7 hari bekerja.

Sekian, terima kasih.
Pihak Teratai Bank

Dear Ms Aisyah binti Kassim,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We reviewed your ATM withdrawal, transaction TXN-0088211 on 17 July 2026. You requested RM1,500.00, but the machine dispensed only RM950.00, leaving a shortfall of RM550.00.

We will refund the shortfall of RM550.00 to your account within 7 working days.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank

Dear Mr Shahrul bin Razak,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We have received your dispute about transaction TXN-0143340 of RM2,213.95 at LUXEGOODS LONDON on 19 September 2026.

Our fraud team is now investigating this transaction. They will contact you within 3 working days, and will then update you at least every 10 working days until the investigation is complete.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank

Dear Ms Meena a/p Pillai,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We reviewed your transfer of RM4,687.10 to Nur Aina binti Kassim on 28 August 2026 (transaction TXN-0124894). The transfer failed, and the money was never returned to your account.

We will refund RM4,687.10 to your account within 7 working days. We apologise for the inconvenience this has caused you.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank

Puan Aisyah binti Kassim,

Terima kasih kerana menghubungi pihak bank. Setakat ini, pihak bank tidak dapat mengenal pasti transaksi yang Puan maksudkan, dan belum ada sebarang keputusan dibuat.

Untuk membantu kami menyemak perkara ini, sila balas dengan maklumat berikut: tarikh transaksi, jumlah wang, serta nama peniaga atau nama penerima.

Setelah menerima maklumat tersebut, pihak bank akan meneruskan semakan.

Sekian, terima kasih.
Pihak Teratai Bank
